plans.title: Rebuildable project-local artifact index
deliverables: A deterministic index generated from canonical active files and archived manifests
Terminal tree and overview projections that default to active state and expose explicit history detail commands
A rebuild command or automatic deterministic rebuild after index loss
acceptance_checks: Deleting the derived index does not invalidate canonical project state and rebuilding produces the same hash
Every summary row resolves to an exact artifact hash and locator
The index never becomes a release or package source of truth

plans.title: Portable self-describing history bundle
deliverables: A stable archive format using canonical JSON members plus a sorted JSON manifest
Versioned restoration metadata and no dependency on repository Git history
acceptance_checks: A bundle round-trip reproduces all source artifacts byte-for-byte
The bundle can be validated and restored on an offline clean machine with the installed MOZAK binary
Unknown archive versions and path traversal members fail before extraction
The archive format remains inspectable with standard tools even when the derived index is unavailable
